summary: Sephardic Alliance goes through how many hakafot are done on Simchat Torah in different communities. The class discusses the customs of Damascus, Egypt, and Aleppo, focusing on the Aleppo custom of doing seven sets of hakafot.
questions: How many hakafot do different communities do on Simchat Torah?
What was the custom of hakafot in Aleppo?
When did communities in Brooklyn preserve the custom of hakafot before Shacharit?
